caption: The shipped 'Logic Gate RAM 4x4' example (issue #1408): the ISA-sized hierarchical RAM — the 2-bit address decode, the LOAD/data copy trees and the read-MUX combines at top level, the four word-cell instances CELL0–CELL3 routed once and frozen; only the inter-cell wires route at top level.

The Logic tab after the write/read demo (en): 3 was stored in word 0 and 12 in word 3 (one LOAD + clock each), then LOAD went low — with A0=A1=1 the read bus Q shows 12; the sixteen register bits of the four instanced word cells are listed in the register readout.

The Logic tab after the write/read demo (de): 3 was stored in word 0 and 12 in word 3 (one LOAD + clock each), then LOAD went low — with A0=A1=1 the read bus Q shows 12; the sixteen register bits of the four instanced word cells are listed in the register readout.
